title: [ANNOUNCE] xwayland 26.0.99.901
author: Hacker News
content:
Olivier Fourdan ofourdan at redhat.com
Wed Aug 19 13:37:02 UTC 2026

  • Previous message (by thread): [ANNOUNCE] xload 1.2.2
  • Messages sorted by: [ date ] [ thread ] [ subject ] [ author ]
As per the schedule, I am pleased to announce Xwayland 26.0.99.901,
the first release candidate of the upcoming standalone Xwayland 26.1.0
release (or Xwayland 26.1.0 rc1 for short).

Some notable changes since Xwayland 24.1 include:

     * EGLStream support is removed.
     * Xwayland rootful implements a clipboard/primary selection bridge
       (enabled with "-clipboard"), allowing copy/paste between rootful
       Xwayland and the rest of the Wayland desktop.
     * Multi-seat via Xi2: Wayland seats and their devices are mirrored
       into an XInput 2 hierarchy.
     * Support for "wl_fixes", namely destroy_global and ack_global_remove.
     * RandR emulation now prefers native modes up to the physical
       resolution, and emulated modes now take rotation into account.
     * Xwayland rootful fullscreen defaults to the actual output resolution
       instead of scaling up a resolution of 640x480.
     * Support for xdg-system-bell: Xwayland now rings the system bell
       through the Wayland system-bell protocol when the compositor
       supports it.

Testing of this release candidate would be greatly appreciated.

Please report any issues at https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/xserver/-/issues

The following shortlogs include all the changes since the previous
xwayland-24.1 branch was first created (more than two years ago), not
all of those changes are relevant to Xwayland though:

aiSummary: 此公告介绍了 Xwayland 26.0.99.901，即 Xwayland 26.1.0 的首个候选版本，重点突出了 EGLStream 移除、剪贴板桥接、多座位支持以及各种错误修复。
oneSentenceSummary: 此公告介绍了 Xwayland 26.0.99.901，即 Xwayland 26.1.0 的首个候选版本，重点突出了 EGLStream 移除、剪贴板桥接、多座位支持以及各种错误修复。
summary: Olivier Fourdan 宣布 Xwayland 26.0.99.901 为即将发布的独立版本 Xwayland 26.1.0 的首个候选版本。相较于 Xwayland 24.1，显著变更包括：移除 EGLStream 支持；为根 ful Xwayland 添加剪贴板/主要选择桥接（通过 "-clipboard" 启用）；通过 Xi2 实现多座位支持，将 Wayland 座位和设备映射为 XInput 2 层级；支持 wl_fixes（destroy_global 和 ack_global_remove）；RandR 模拟优先选择原生模式，最高可达物理分辨率并考虑旋转；Xwayland 根 ful 全屏默认使用实际输出分辨率，而非将 640x480 放大。公告还增加了对 xdg-system-bell 的支持，使得在合成器支持的情况下，Xwayland 能通过 Wayland system-bell 协议触发系统铃声。鼓励用户测试此候选版本，并通过提供的 GitLab 链接报告问题。

mainPoints.explanation: 这简化了代码库，使 Xwayland 与现代 Wayland 协议保持一致，消除了旧图形栈的复杂性。

mainPoints.point: 根 ful Xwayland 的剪贴板/主要选择桥接。
mainPoints.explanation: 通过 "-clipboard" 标志启用，可在根 ful Xwayland 窗口与 Wayland 桌面其余部分之间实现无缝复制/粘贴。

mainPoints.point: 通过 Xi2 实现多座位：将 Wayland 座位和设备映射为 XInput 2 层级。
mainPoints.explanation: 这通过将 Wayland 座位呈现为标准 XInput 设备来改进多座位处理，提升了与现有 X11 工具包的兼容性。

mainPoints.point: RandR 模拟优先选择原生模式并考虑旋转；全屏默认使用实际输出分辨率。
mainPoints.explanation: 这些变更提供了更准确的屏幕分辨率处理，特别是在旋转显示器上，并避免了全屏模式下的不必要缩放。

keyQuotes: 按照计划，我很高兴宣布 Xwayland 26.0.99.901 为即将发布的独立版本 Xwayland 26.1.0 的首个候选版本（简称 Xwayland 26.1.0 rc1）。
非常欢迎对该候选版本进行测试。
